## Outcome

Describe the user-facing or repository-facing result.
Open after the first coherent commit as a draft; mark ready when the focused
evidence below is complete.

## Focused evidence

List only the focused evidence produced while implementing the change. GitHub
already records the broad exact-head checks.

## Adversarial risks

Describe material unresolved risks and any missing evidence; omit speculative
risks for a trivial change. For import/compiler fidelity or revision/claim
correctness, identify the failure modes challenged and the evidence addressing
them. Confirm that the diff contains no private material.
